Not one jot wiser than before. Oh, I have my degrees, they call me Master of Arts, and Doctor! And for these ten years now I’ve led my students around by the nose, upstairs, downstairs, backwards, forwards— and learned? That there’s nothing to be learned. Nothing! And that is the dread that eats at my heart’s core. Oh, but I’m no dunce. I’m better than all these “doctors,” these “masters,” these “clerks” and “priests,” and not even fear of Hell or the Devil can make me tremble with scruples or doubts. And what is my reward for all that? The loss of all joy in life. Why pretend? Why assume I know anything worth knowing? Why delude myself I can teach anything to improve or convert mankind? And what has it got me? Just this! I’m a pauper. Or nearly so. I have neither property nor wealth, nor worldly honor. No glory. Show me a dog who would lead such a life!

@@U00083@@
没有比以前聪明一丁点。哦，我有学位，他们叫我文学硕士和博士！这十年来，我一直牵着我的学生的鼻子，上楼、下楼、向后、向前——然后学到了什么？就是说没有什么可学的。没有什么！这就是吞噬我内心的恐惧。哦，但我不是傻瓜。我比所有这些“医生”、这些“大师”、这些“职员”和“牧师”都要优秀，甚至连对地狱或魔鬼的恐惧也不能使我因顾忌或怀疑而颤抖。我对这一切的回报是什么？失去生活中所有的快乐。为什么要假装？为什么假设我知道任何值得知道的事情？为什么要欺骗自己，我可以教授任何东西来改善或改变人类？它给我带来了什么？就这个！我是一个乞丐。或者说几乎如此。我既没有财产，也没有财富，也没有世俗的荣誉。没有荣耀。告诉我一只狗会过这样的生活！
